questions.question: How does Psalm 68 begin?
options: 'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'
'How lovely is your dwelling place, O LORD of hosts'
'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'
'God shall arise, his enemies shall be scattered'
questions.answer: 'God shall arise, his enemies shall be scattered'

questions.question: How is God described as caring for the vulnerable?
options: A shepherd to the whole flock and keeper of the gate
A teacher to the simple and guide to the lost
A judge to the nations and ruler of kings
A father to the fatherless and protector of widows
questions.answer: A father to the fatherless and protector of widows
